reviewContext.userProblem: After run 1 the owner's live run found seven UI/API defects that the mock hid (requirements section 8, L1-L7). The owner fixed O1 (overdue ref_id length) and O2 (the E3 flow blocking p08) at the checkpoint.
requiredOutcomes: L1: the timeline shows occurred_at ?? recorded_at; DataEvent.occurred_at and DataAsset.last_seen_at are nullable in the UI types.
L2: collector:<id> actors show the collector name (Telescreen when the config is missing) through InventoryActorDirectory, wired in wiring_v14.py.
L3: the reference select preselects member:<handle>/team:<slug>, keeps unknown stored values, and an unchanged save keeps the value.
L4: ItemCountChart renders points that arrive after mount.
L5: separated text in count tabs, timeline rows, list name cells and the breadcrumb.
L6: admins see Field schema in the Data and Settings secondary navs.
L7: an Overdue tag in the list State column.
Mock fixtures have null occurred_at, collector/system actors, reference values and a multi-point series for data-asset-01; every regression test was red on 3c5c1dd.
p08 re-verifies the integrated tree; all gates pass; plans and both manifests are archived; docs updated; committed and pushed to feat/data-inventory.
nonGoals: No DDL, route, permission, response key or dependency change; D1-D24 unchanged; p01-p07 not redispatched.
No rewrite of stored actor refs; no change to DirectoryActorDirectory or issue activity.
No C5 custom push identity change (pending owner decision).
constraints: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md: English only, no emojis; plans under 400 lines; Python files under 1000 lines.
Strict typing (no Any, object, dict or **kwargs; dataclasses or enums; no type-ignore); typelint, ruff ANN/PGH and ty not weakened.
Raw detected values and raw item keys are never persisted, logged, indexed, notified, exported or returned; the leak matrix stays green.
Default uv run pytest passes offline; integration and live tests skip and are never listed as verification.
Conventions 2, 7 and 7a; workers never run git checkout/restore/stash/reset/clean/commit/add/push.
intentionalTradeoffs: Serial waves despite disjoint writePaths, because of the shared working directory (design 17.6).
Collector names appear in the data timeline; every data.read holder also holds collectors.read, so nothing new is exposed (design 17.3).
The live L1-L7 checks are owner-only after the run.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Design 17.2 L1: the UI types follow API 9.1 nullability (occurred_at and last_seen_at nullable) because the API sets occurred_at only for person-supplied events; the timeline falls back to recorded_at.

Design 17.3 L2: collector actors are resolved at read time by an InventoryActorDirectory wrapper, because lifecycle events are append-only and stored refs must not be rewritten; the shared DirectoryActorDirectory and issue activity stay unchanged.
Design 17.2 L3/L4: Solid reactivity fixes (per-option selected, reactive Show over points) because a component body runs once and resources resolve after mount.
Design 17.2 L5: explicit DOM separators plus CSS rules in ui.css and a new pages/data/data.css, keeping accessible names unchanged.
Design 17.2 L6: entriesFor(area, can) receives the permission check so Field schema appears for data_fields.admin in the Data and Settings navs, as section 10.1 specifies.
Design 17.4: mock fixtures gain the live shapes (null occurred_at, collector/system actors, reference values, multi-point series) so the mock can no longer hide these defects.
Design 17.6: one plan p09 (backend L2 is one module plus one wiring line), then p08 re-verify, serial because of the shared working directory.
supportedEdgeCases: collector:<id> whose config was deleted resolves to Telescreen; repeated collector ids are read once per call; input length and order preserved.
A stored reference value not in the directory (inactive member, deleted team) stays selectable as 'Current value (not in directory)'; an unchanged save writes no metadata_changed event.
Item count chart: no points shows 'No item count history', one point a flat line, two or more a step line, including points arriving after mount.
last_seen_at null renders as an em dash in the list and detail; manual events keep their occurred_at.
A member (no data_fields.admin) sees no Field schema entry in either nav.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Rewriting historical actor_ref values in stored events.
C5 custom push identity semantics (pending owner decision).
Live L1-L7 confirmation and PostgreSQL/Meilisearch integration runs (owner-only, skipped offline).
